label: Synthetic benchmark trace. Not customer data.

trace.task: Document Q&A agent — answer 3 policy questions — prompt blocks have no block_id

cost_assumptions.note: Waste calculated as 18520 tokens × 2 repetitions after first occurrence at 2.5/M input tokens. First occurrence (step-1) excluded. Output tokens not counted because waste is on the input side.

findings.evidence: Detection method: text_similarity. The "Full employee handbook content" block (18,520 tokens) appears across 3 model calls. Block ID was not available or unreliable. Detection relied on normalized text similarity (score: 100%). Block was reused 2 times after first occurrence (step-1).
findings.explanation: The "Full employee handbook content" block (18,520 tokens) was included in the model context 3 times but only needed once. After the first use in step-1, the remaining 2 occurrences (step-2, step-3) passed the same content again, generating an estimated $0.09 in waste. This represents approximately 11% of the total run cost.
findings.recommended_fix: Cache the content of "Full employee handbook content" after step-1. Pass a reference ID or cached summary into later steps (step-2, step-3) instead of the full block.
